mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering economic slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (above 2% annualized) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth > 2% annualized, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, triggering expectations of tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payrolls trend indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDP growth above 2.5% annualized), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and policy tightening expectations.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both INDPRO and HOUST decline in the same month, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
